text: Young Ida and her older sister Anna, who has nonverbal autism, [move with their parents into a new apartment|trigger|making a new home], and Ida befriends Ben, a boy with telekinetic and telepathic gifts who [crushes a stray cat's skull on the stairs|images|animals and birds]. With Aisha, who shares the gift, Anna begins to speak, and [the children's powers grow strongest together|threat|powers of the mind]. But Ben turns violent, and soon he is [steering adults to kill for him|rules|it gets inside you].
